news.titleEn: Nvidia, Oracle, CoreWeave and other AI stocks sink on OpenAI revenue report
news.conclusionEn: AI stocks sold off after a report that OpenAI told investors its annualized revenue was about $50 billion, well below the widely cited $68 billion.
news.conclusionZh: OpenAI年化收入约500亿美元低于预期，AI股集体下跌。
news.whyEn: OpenAI is the bellwether customer of the AI build-out; weaker revenue raises doubts over whether hundreds of billions in chip and data-center spending will pay off.
news.whyZh: OpenAI是AI基建的核心买家，收入不及预期令市场质疑巨额算力投资回报。
news.detailEn: According to the Financial Times, OpenAI told investors it reached roughly $50 billion in annualized revenue at the end of September, versus the ~$68 billion figure reported late last month; the higher figure reportedly included gross revenue before sharing with partners. Oracle fell nearly 6%, CoreWeave almost 8%, Nvidia about 3%, AMD 4% and Intel 5%, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index dropped 3.4%. The Nasdaq 100 had its worst day in seven weeks. Investors will now scrutinize upcoming earnings from cloud and chip companies for signs that AI spending is cooling.
news.detailZh: 据《金融时报》报道，OpenAI告诉投资者其9月底年化收入约为500亿美元，低于上月广泛流传的约680亿美元，后者据称包含了与合作方分成前的总收入。甲骨文跌近6%、CoreWeave跌近8%、英伟达跌约3%、AMD跌4%、英特尔跌5%，费城半导体指数下跌3.4%。纳斯达克100指数录得七周来最差单日表现。接下来投资者会更仔细审视云计算和芯片公司的财报，寻找AI支出降温的迹象。

news.titleEn: Oil falls as Trump comments on Iran talks ease supply concerns
news.conclusionEn: Oil prices slipped after Trump said talks with Iran were productive and no attack was planned before the Nov. 3 midterm elections.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普称美伊谈判有成效、中期选举前不打伊朗，油价回落。
news.whyEn: With Brent above $100 and the Strait of Hormuz disrupted, any sign of de-escalation directly affects inflation, rate-hike expectations and energy-importing economies.
news.whyZh: 布油仍超100美元，局势缓和信号直接影响通胀、加息预期和能源进口国。
news.detailEn: Brent crude fell to around $103 a barrel and WTI to about $91 on Friday, after settling 4% higher on Thursday on renewed attacks on Gulf shipping. Iran's foreign minister said Tehran is reviewing the U.S. response to its proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days. The strait carried about 20% of global oil and fuel shipments before the war. Prices remain highly sensitive to headlines, and Brent is still on track for a weekly gain.
news.detailZh: 周五布伦特原油跌至每桶约103美元，WTI约91美元；此前周四因海湾航运再遭袭击而大涨4%。伊朗外长表示，德黑兰正在研究美方对其「7天内重开霍尔木兹海峡」提议的回应。战前该海峡承载全球约20%的石油和燃料运输。油价对消息面高度敏感，布油本周仍有望录得周线上涨。

news.titleEn: A hurricane could cripple US refining when the world can least afford it
news.conclusionEn: Hurricane Isaias forced about 63% of U.S. Gulf of Mexico oil output offline and threatens Gulf Coast refineries ahead of landfall.
news.conclusionZh: 飓风伊萨亚斯逼近，美墨西哥湾约63%原油产量停产。
news.whyEn: U.S. refineries run near full capacity with low fuel inventories, so storm damage could push up gasoline and diesel prices already strained by the Iran war.
news.whyZh: 美炼厂接近满负荷、成品油库存低，飓风受损将推高已受战争冲击的油价。
news.detailEn: Isaias, the first Atlantic hurricane of the 2026 season, is forecast to make landfall near the Mississippi-Alabama-Florida border on Friday night. U.S. regulators said roughly 1.28 million barrels per day of offshore oil and over half of Gulf gas output had been shut in, with 121 platforms evacuated. The Gulf Coast is home to about half of U.S. refining capacity. Extended refinery outages could tighten global fuel markets that are already disrupted by the Strait of Hormuz crisis.
news.detailZh: 伊萨亚斯是2026年大西洋首个飓风，预计周五晚在密西西比、阿拉巴马与佛罗里达交界附近登陆。美国监管机构称，约每日128万桶海上原油产量及过半天然气产量已停产，121座平台已撤离。墨西哥湾沿岸集中了美国约一半的炼油产能。如果炼厂长时间停工，将进一步收紧本已因霍尔木兹危机而紧张的全球燃料市场。

news.titleEn: European Bank Stocks Head for Biggest Two-Day Slump Since March
news.conclusionEn: European bank shares fell for a second day as renewed worries over French government debt hit lenders like Societe Generale and Deutsche Bank.
news.conclusionZh: 法国债务担忧再起，欧洲银行股录得3月以来最大两日跌幅。
news.whyEn: Banks hold large amounts of sovereign bonds, so French fiscal stress can spill into credit conditions and equity markets across the eurozone.
news.whyZh: 银行大量持有国债，法国财政压力可能波及整个欧元区信贷和股市。
news.detailEn: The Stoxx 600 banks index fell as much as 2.2% on Thursday after a 3.3% drop on Wednesday, its steepest two-day decline since March. Societe Generale is down about 25% from its August peak and Deutsche Bank about 18% from last month's high. The selloff threatens to derail a strong rally in European bank stocks this year. Investors are watching French politics and bond spreads versus German Bunds for further signs of stress.
news.detailZh: 斯托克600银行指数周四盘中最多下跌2.2%，周三已下跌3.3%，为3月以来最大两日跌幅。法国兴业银行较8月高点已跌约25%，德意志银行较上月高点跌约18%。这波抛售可能终结欧洲银行股今年的强劲涨势。投资者正密切关注法国政局以及法德国债利差，判断压力是否进一步加剧。

news.titleEn: ECB Officials Saw Last Rate Hike as Proportionate Response to Inflation
news.conclusionEn: Minutes-style accounts show ECB policymakers viewed September's rate hike as a proportionate response to energy-driven inflation.
news.conclusionZh: 欧央行会议纪要显示，官员认为9月加息是应对通胀的适度之举。
news.whyEn: The accounts signal how willing the ECB is to keep tightening while oil shocks lift prices and growth weakens, affecting the euro and European bonds.
news.whyZh: 显示欧央行在油价推高通胀、增长放缓时的加息意愿，影响欧元和欧债。
news.detailEn: The European Central Bank raised rates last month as the Iran war and high energy prices pushed up inflation. The published accounts show officials framed the move as measured rather than the start of an aggressive cycle. Markets are trying to gauge whether more hikes will follow as both the Fed and ECB lean hawkish. The renewed stress in French debt and bank stocks adds a financial-stability dimension to the ECB's next decisions.
news.detailZh: 受伊朗战争和高能源价格推高通胀影响，欧洲央行上月加息。公布的会议纪要显示，官员将此次加息定位为适度举措，而非激进加息周期的开端。在美联储和欧央行都偏鹰派的背景下，市场正在判断后续是否还会加息。法国国债和银行股的新一轮压力，也让欧央行接下来的决策多了金融稳定方面的考量。

news.titleEn: WTO Raises Global Trade Forecast as AI Demand Offsets Geopolitical Strains
news.conclusionEn: The WTO lifted its global goods trade outlook as booming AI-related imports outweighed drag from the Iran war and trade tensions.
news.conclusionZh: AI需求抵消地缘冲击，世贸组织上调全球货物贸易预测。
news.whyEn: It shows how concentrated global trade growth has become in AI hardware — which makes it vulnerable if AI spending cools, as the OpenAI news hints.
news.whyZh: 说明全球贸易增长高度依赖AI硬件，一旦AI投资降温风险会集中暴露。
news.detailEn: The World Trade Organization raised its forecast for merchandise trade growth, citing strong demand for semiconductors, servers and other AI-related equipment. This demand has offset disruptions from the war in the Middle East and higher tariffs. Exporters in Asia, especially Taiwan, South Korea and Southeast Asia, have been the main beneficiaries. The WTO's outlook implies that a slowdown in AI investment would be a key downside risk to global trade.
news.detailZh: 世界贸易组织上调了货物贸易增长预测，理由是半导体、服务器等AI相关设备需求强劲。这部分需求抵消了中东战争和关税上升带来的冲击。亚洲出口地区，尤其是台湾、韩国和东南亚是主要受益者。这也意味着，AI投资一旦放缓，将成为全球贸易的主要下行风险。

news.titleEn: As China and the EU begin crunch trade talks, optimism is in short supply
news.conclusionEn: EU trade chief Maroš Šefčovič is in Beijing for two days of talks as Brussels' October deadline for China to deliver concrete trade results arrives.
news.conclusionZh: 欧盟贸易专员赴京谈判，欧方给中方的10月期限已到。
news.whyEn: Failure could trigger new EU tariffs on Chinese chemicals, hybrid cars and machine tools, escalating a trade fight with a deficit near €400 billion a year.
news.whyZh: 谈不拢欧盟或对中国化工、混动车等加征关税，贸易摩擦将升级。
news.detailEn: Šefčovič and Chinese Commerce Minister Wang Wentao are co-chairing the second EU-China Trade and Investment Council on October 8–9. The EU wants curbs on subsidized overcapacity in cars, steel and batteries, better market access for European firms and reliable rare-earth supplies. The EU's trade deficit with China is expected to approach €400 billion this year as Chinese exports to Europe surge. Analysts expect new EU trade-defense measures by the end of October if talks fall short.
news.detailZh: 谢夫乔维奇与中国商务部长王文涛于10月8日至9日共同主持第二届中欧贸易投资理事会。欧方诉求包括：限制汽车、钢铁和电池领域的补贴性产能过剩，改善欧企在华市场准入，以及稳定的稀土供应。随着中国对欧出口激增，欧盟今年对华贸易逆差预计接近4000亿欧元。分析人士预计，如果谈判成果不足，欧盟会在10月底前推出新的贸易救济措施。

news.titleEn: Explosions heard in Saudi capital Riyadh after Houthis' deadly attacks on airports
news.conclusionEn: Houthi attacks on Riyadh and Abha airports killed three and wounded 36, and the Saudi-led coalition struck back at 82 targets in Yemen.
news.conclusionZh: 胡塞武装袭击沙特两座机场致3死36伤，沙特联军大规模反击。
news.whyEn: A reignited Saudi-Houthi war adds another front to the Gulf crisis, raising risks for aviation, oil infrastructure and Red Sea shipping.
news.whyZh: 沙胡战火重燃为海湾危机再添战线，威胁航空、石油设施和红海航运。
news.detailEn: The Iran-backed Houthis said they targeted King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh with a ballistic missile. The Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed 82 military targets in retaliation, including missile facilities and command centers. Yemen's civil war reignited in July after a four-year ceasefire and has displaced more than 200,000 people. Further attacks on Saudi soil could add a risk premium to oil prices on top of the Strait of Hormuz disruption.
news.detailZh: 伊朗支持的胡塞武装称用弹道导弹袭击了利雅得哈立德国王国际机场。沙特领导的联军表示，已摧毁82个军事目标作为报复，包括导弹设施和指挥中心。也门内战在4年停火后于7月重燃，已造成逾20万人流离失所。如果沙特本土继续遇袭，油价可能在霍尔木兹危机之外再添一层风险溢价。

news.titleEn: U.S. suspends Microsoft, Adobe from green card labor program in foreign worker crackdown
news.conclusionEn: The U.S. Labor Department suspended Microsoft and Adobe from its permanent labor certification program, a key step in employer-sponsored green cards.
news.conclusionZh: 美国劳工部暂停微软和Adobe参与绿卡劳工认证项目。
news.whyEn: It escalates the Trump administration's crackdown on foreign hiring and could disrupt tech firms' ability to retain skilled immigrant workers.
news.whyZh: 特朗普政府收紧外籍雇佣再升级，影响科技公司留住外籍技术人才。
news.detailEn: The Permanent Labor Certification (PERM) process requires employers to show no qualified U.S. workers are available before sponsoring a foreign employee for a green card. Suspending two of the largest tech employers sends a strong signal to the wider industry. Many H-1B workers at these companies rely on PERM to move toward permanent residency. Other large tech employers may face similar scrutiny as the administration widens its immigration enforcement.
news.detailZh: 永久劳工认证（PERM）要求雇主在为外籍员工申请绿卡前，证明找不到合格的美国本土员工。暂停两家科技巨头的资格，对整个行业释放了强烈信号。这些公司的大量H-1B员工依靠PERM走向永久居留。随着政府扩大移民执法，其他大型科技公司也可能面临类似审查。

news.titleEn: Witnesses spot Eritrean troops inside northern Ethiopia as tensions flare
news.conclusionEn: Eritrean troops were seen inside Ethiopia's Tigray region days after the two countries cut diplomatic ties, and Ethiopia demanded their withdrawal.
news.conclusionZh: 厄立特里亚军队进入埃塞俄比亚提格雷，两国断交后冲突升级。
news.whyEn: A direct war between Ethiopia and Eritrea could destabilize the Horn of Africa near the Red Sea, already a flashpoint for global shipping.
news.whyZh: 两国若直接开战，将动摇紧邻红海航道的非洲之角地区稳定。
news.detailEn: Reuters witnesses saw Eritrean soldiers driving through a northern Ethiopian town, and the troops reportedly came under fire from Ethiopian drones. Eritrea severed ties after Ethiopia closed its embassy in Asmara and expelled Eritrean diplomats. The escalation follows an offensive launched by the TPLF and allied rebel groups on September 23. Ethiopia's government called the incursion an invasion, raising fears of a repeat of the 1998–2000 border war.
news.detailZh: 路透社目击者看到厄立特里亚士兵驾车穿过埃塞北部一座城镇，据报这些部队遭到埃塞无人机攻击。此前埃塞关闭驻阿斯马拉使馆并驱逐厄方外交官，厄立特里亚随即宣布断交。这次升级源于提人阵及其盟友叛军9月23日发起的攻势。埃塞政府称此次越境为「入侵」，引发外界对重演1998至2000年边境战争的担忧。

businessTips.explanationEn: Second-order thinking means asking "and then what?" — looking beyond the immediate effect of a decision to its knock-on consequences. First-order thinking stops at the obvious outcome, which competitors also see. Considering second- and third-order effects helps avoid decisions that look good today but backfire later. It is especially useful for pricing, policy and hiring decisions.
businessTips.explanationZh: 二阶思维就是多问一句「然后呢？」——不只看决策的直接结果，还要看它引发的连锁反应。一阶思维只停留在显而易见的结果上，而这一层竞争对手也看得到。考虑二阶、三阶效应，可以避免那些眼下看着不错、日后却适得其反的决定。它在定价、制定政策和招聘决策中尤其有用。
businessTips.exampleEn: A deep discount boosts sales this month (first order), but trains customers to wait for sales and erodes margins (second order). Today's news is another example: higher reported AI revenue lifted chip stocks, but once investors questioned the figure, the same logic drove a broad selloff.
businessTips.exampleZh: 大幅打折能拉高本月销量（一阶效应），但也会让顾客习惯等促销、侵蚀利润（二阶效应）。今天的新闻也是例子：亮眼的AI收入数字曾推高芯片股，可一旦投资者开始怀疑这个数字，同样的逻辑就引发了全面抛售。

businessTips.explanationEn: LTV (customer lifetime value) is the total gross profit a customer brings over their relationship with you; CAC (customer acquisition cost) is what you spend to win that customer. The LTV:CAC ratio tells you whether growth is profitable. A common rule of thumb is 3:1 or higher; below 1:1 means every new customer loses money. It is also worth tracking how many months it takes to earn back CAC (payback period).
businessTips.explanationZh: LTV（客户终身价值）是一个客户在整个合作期内为你带来的毛利总额；CAC（获客成本）是你为赢得这个客户花的钱。LTV:CAC比值能告诉你增长是否赚钱。常见经验值是3:1或以上；低于1:1意味着每多一个客户就多亏一份钱。同时也值得关注收回获客成本需要几个月（回本周期）。
businessTips.exampleEn: A side-business selling a $20/month template subscription with 80% margin and an average 10-month lifespan has LTV of about $160. If Instagram ads cost $40 per subscriber, LTV:CAC is 4:1 — worth scaling. If ad costs rise to $120, the ratio drops to about 1.3:1 and you should improve retention or find cheaper channels first.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一个副业卖每月20美元的模板订阅，毛利率80%，客户平均留存10个月，LTV约160美元。如果Instagram广告每获取一位订阅者花40美元，LTV:CAC为4:1，值得加大投放。如果广告成本涨到120美元，比值降到约1.3:1，就应先提高留存或寻找更便宜的获客渠道。

businessTips.explanationEn: Gross revenue counts the full amount customers pay, while net revenue subtracts the portion passed on to partners, resellers or suppliers. Accounting rules decide which to report based on whether a company acts as principal or agent. The same business can look much bigger on a gross basis, so comparing companies requires checking which definition is used. Investors should also distinguish run-rate (annualized) figures from audited revenue.
businessTips.explanationZh: 总收入（gross）指客户支付的全部金额；净收入（net）则扣除了转付给合作方、分销商或供应商的部分。会计准则会根据公司是「主要责任人」还是「代理人」决定采用哪种口径。同一门生意按总额口径会显得大得多，因此比较公司时必须确认用的是哪种定义。投资者还要分清「年化运行率」数字和经审计的实际收入。
businessTips.exampleEn: This week, OpenAI's widely reported ~$68 billion annualized revenue reportedly included revenue before partner sharing, while the ~$50 billion figure given to investors was closer to a comparable basis — a gap that wiped billions off AI stocks. Similarly, a travel booking site reporting gross bookings looks far larger than its actual commission-based net revenue.
businessTips.exampleZh: 本周，被广泛报道的OpenAI约680亿美元年化收入据称包含了与合作方分成前的收入，而它向投资者提供的约500亿美元更接近可比口径——这一差距让AI股市值蒸发数十亿美元。同理，在线旅游平台公布的「总预订额」远大于它真正靠佣金获得的净收入。
